From 11cb63b0d1a0685e0831ae3c77223e002ef18189 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Victor Nogueira <victor@mojatatu.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:43:48 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] net/sched: Only allow act_ct to bind to clsact/ingress qdiscs
 and shared blocks

As Paolo said earlier [1]:

"Since the blamed commit below, classify can return TC_ACT_CONSUMED while
the current skb being held by the defragmentation engine. As reported by
GangMin Kim, if such packet is that may cause a UaF when the defrag engine
later on tries to tuch again such packet."

act_ct was never meant to be used in the egress path, however some users
are attaching it to egress today [2]. Attempting to reach a middle
ground, we noticed that, while most qdiscs are not handling
TC_ACT_CONSUMED, clsact/ingress qdiscs are. With that in mind, we
address the issue by only allowing act_ct to bind to clsact/ingress
qdiscs and shared blocks. That way it's still possible to attach act_ct to
egress (albeit only with clsact).

[1] https://lore.kernel.org/netdev/674b8cbfc385c6f37fb29a1de08d8fe5c2b0fbee.1771321118.git.pabeni@redhat.com/
[2] https://lore.kernel.org/netdev/cc6bfb4a-4a2b-42d8-b9ce-7ef6644fb22b@ovn.org/

Reported-by: GangMin Kim <km.kim1503@gmail.com>
Fixes: 3f14b377d01d ("net/sched: act_ct: fix skb leak and crash on ooo frags")
CC: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Victor Nogueira <victor@mojatatu.com>
Acked-by: Jamal Hadi Salim <jhs@mojatatu.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260225134349.1287037-1-victor@mojatatu.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/sched/cls_api.c b/net/sched/cls_api.c
index 343309e9009b..4829c27446e3 100644
--- a/net/sched/cls_api.c
+++ b/net/sched/cls_api.c
@@ -2228,6 +2228,11 @@ static bool is_qdisc_ingress(__u32 classid)
 	return (TC_H_MIN(classid) == TC_H_MIN(TC_H_MIN_INGRESS));
 }
 
+static bool is_ingress_or_clsact(struct tcf_block *block, struct Qdisc *q)
+{
+	return tcf_block_shared(block) || (q && !!(q->flags & TCQ_F_INGRESS));
+}
+
 static int tc_new_tfilter(struct sk_buff *skb, struct nlmsghdr *n,
 			  struct netlink_ext_ack *extack)
 {
@@ -2420,6 +2425,8 @@ static int tc_new_tfilter(struct sk_buff *skb, struct nlmsghdr *n,
 		flags |= TCA_ACT_FLAGS_NO_RTNL;
 	if (is_qdisc_ingress(parent))
 		flags |= TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS;
+	if (is_ingress_or_clsact(block, q))
+		flags |= TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT;
 	err = tp->ops->change(net, skb, tp, cl, t->tcm_handle, tca, &fh,
 			      flags, extack);
 	if (err == 0) {

diff --git a/net/sched/act_ct.c b/net/sched/act_ct.c
index bd51522c7953..7d5e50c921a0 100644
--- a/net/sched/act_ct.c
+++ b/net/sched/act_ct.c
@@ -1360,6 +1360,12 @@ static int tcf_ct_init(struct net *net, struct nlattr *nla,
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 
+	if (bind && !(flags & TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT)) {
+		NL_SET_ERR_MSG_MOD(extack,
+				   "Attaching ct to a non ingress/clsact qdisc is unsupported");
+		return -EOPNOTSUPP;
+	}
+
 	err = nla_parse_nested(tb, TCA_CT_MAX, nla, ct_policy, extack);
 	if (err < 0)
 		return err;

diff --git a/include/net/act_api.h b/include/net/act_api.h
index e1e8f0f7dacb..d11b79107930 100644
--- a/include/net/act_api.h
+++ b/include/net/act_api.h
@@ -70,6 +70,7 @@ struct tc_action {
 #define TCA_ACT_FLAGS_REPLACE	(1U << (TCA_ACT_FLAGS_USER_BITS + 2))
 #define TCA_ACT_FLAGS_NO_RTNL	(1U << (TCA_ACT_FLAGS_USER_BITS + 3))
 #define TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS	(1U << (TCA_ACT_FLAGS_USER_BITS + 4))
+#define TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT	(1U << (TCA_ACT_FLAGS_USER_BITS + 5))
 
 /* Update lastuse only if needed, to avoid dirtying a cache line.
  * We use a temp variable to avoid fetching jiffies twice.

The patch restricts the `act_ct` (connection tracking action) to only be attached to ingress or clsact qdiscs (or shared blocks) to prevent a use‑after‑free bug that occurs when `TC_ACT_CONSUMED` is not properly handled by other qdisc types.

### Modifications per file

1. **`include/net/act_api.h`**  
   - Added a new flag `TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT` (bit 5) to communicate to the action that it is being attached to an ingress/clsact qdisc or a shared block.

2. **`net/sched/cls_api.c`**  
   - Added a helper function `is_ingress_or_clsact()` that returns `true` if the block is shared (`tcf_block_shared(block)`) or the qdisc has the `TCQ_F_INGRESS` flag set.  
   - In `tc_new_tfilter()`, after determining the parent class, the new flag is set on the action flags if `is_ingress_or_clsact()` is true. This flag is passed to the action's `->change()` callback.

3. **`net/sched/act_ct.c`**  
   - In `tcf_ct_init()`, when `bind` is true (i.e., during filter/template instantiation), the code checks whether `TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT` is set in the flags. If not, it fails with `-EOPNOTSUPP` and a descriptive error message, preventing `act_ct` from binding to unsupported qdiscs.

### Relationships between changes

- The new flag definition in `act_api.h` enables communication between the classifier infrastructure and the action module.  
- `cls_api.c` sets the flag only when the filter is attached to an ingress/clsact or shared block, thereby encoding the allowed attachment points.  
- `act_ct.c` uses the flag during binding to enforce the restriction: without the flag, the action refuses to attach, ensuring that `act_ct` is never used on qdiscs that do not handle `TC_ACT_CONSUMED` correctly.  

Together, these changes prevent the use‑after‑free scenario while still allowing `act_ct` on egress when using a `clsact` qdisc (which properly handles the consumed return value).

The patch restricts the `act_ct` action to only bind to ingress/clsact qdiscs or shared blocks, preventing use on other qdiscs (like egress) where it could cause a use-after-free bug. The modifications across three files work together:

- **`include/net/act_api.h`**: Adds a new flag `TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT` to indicate that the action is being attached to a supported qdisc or a shared block.

- **`net/sched/cls_api.c`**: Introduces helper `is_ingress_or_clsact()` that returns true if the block is shared or if the qdisc has the `TCQ_F_INGRESS` flag (covers both ingress and clsact). In `tc_new_tfilter`, this flag is set on the action flags when binding.

- **`net/sched/act_ct.c`**: In `tcf_ct_init`, during a bind operation, the new flag is checked. If it is not set, initialization fails with `-EOPNOTSUPP` and a clear error message, preventing attachment to unsupported qdiscs.

The relationship is a two‑step validation: the filter creation code tags the action with the flag only when the qdisc/block is allowed, and `act_ct` then verifies that tag at init time. This ensures `act_ct` is never bound to egress qdiscs other than clsact, avoiding the UaF reported.

The patch restricts `act_ct` from binding to non-ingress/clsact qdiscs or non-shared blocks, preventing use in egress paths that can cause use-after-free (UaF) bugs. The changes span three files:

### Modifications per file

1. **`include/net/act_api.h`**  
   - Added a new action flag `TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT` (bit 5) to indicate that the action is being bound to an ingress, clsact, or shared block.

2. **`net/sched/cls_api.c`**  
   - Added helper function `is_ingress_or_clsact(struct tcf_block *block, struct Qdisc *q)` that returns `true` if the block is shared or if the qdisc has the `TCQ_F_INGRESS` flag (i.e., it is an ingress or clsact qdisc).  
   - In `tc_new_tfilter()`, after setting `TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS` based on the parent classid, added a call to `is_ingress_or_clsact(block, q)` to additionally set `TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT` when binding to these allowed types.

3. **`net/sched/act_ct.c`**  
   - In `tcf_ct_init()`, added a check at the beginning: if the action is being bound (`bind` is true) and the new flag is *not* set, reject the operation with an appropriate error message (`EOPNOTSUPP`). This ensures `act_ct` can only be bound to ingress/clsact qdiscs or shared blocks.

### Relationships between the modifications

- The new flag defined in `act_api.h` serves as a communication mechanism between the classifier core (`cls_api.c`) and the `act_ct` module (`act_ct.c`).  
- `cls_api.c` sets the flag during filter creation when the binding context matches the allowed qdisc types.  
- `act_ct.c` checks this flag during its initialization to enforce the restriction, returning an error if the flag is absent (i.e., the binding attempt is invalid).  

Together, these changes prevent `act_ct` from being attached to egress qdiscs that do not correctly handle `TC_ACT_CONSUMED`, solving the reported UaF vulnerability.

        Patch:
        diff --git a/net/sched/act_ct.c b/net/sched/act_ct.c
index bd51522c7953..7d5e50c921a0 100644
--- a/net/sched/act_ct.c
+++ b/net/sched/act_ct.c
@@ -1360,6 +1360,12 @@ static int tcf_ct_init(struct net *net, struct nlattr *nla,
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 
+	if (bind && !(flags & TCA_ACT_FLAGS_AT_INGRESS_OR_CLSACT)) {
+		NL_SET_ERR_MSG_MOD(extack,
+				   "Attaching ct to a non ingress/clsact qdisc is unsupported");
+		return -EOPNOTSUPP;
+	}
+
 	err = nla_parse_nested(tb, TCA_CT_MAX, nla, ct_policy, extack);
 	if (err < 0)
 		return err;

        Root cause:
        The act_ct action can return TC_ACT_CONSUMED while holding the skb for defragmentation. When attached to egress qdiscs (non-ingress/clsact) that do not properly handle TC_ACT_CONSUMED, the skb may be freed prematurely, leading to a use-after-free vulnerability.
